source_receipt.instruction: 15C — Symptom tab. Symptom trend content is shown for the selected symptom. - CHANGE TO : Use one unified symptom-pattern graph rather than a separate graph for each symptom. Plot the user’s logged symptoms together across their cycle timeline so they can see when each symptom tends to occur and identify recurring patterns across cycles. Only include symptoms the user has actually logged, clearly distinguish recorded observations from any calculated pattern or estimate, and never fabricate missing symptom data. Allow individual symptoms to be toggled on/off within the same graph when the user wants a less crowded view, rather than navigating to separate symptom-specific graphs. The visualization must remain readable when many symptoms have been logged and should summarize patterns only when sufficient repeated data exists; with limited data, show the observations without implying that a reliable pattern has been established.
